consent.title: Dikgetho tsa hao tsa lekunutu

consent.PLATFORMHelp: Ho a hlokahala ho sebedisa app. Re boloka profaele ya hao, tswelopele le diphetho tsa expo.

consent.guardianIntro: {name} o kene ho Sgela, app ya mahala e tswang ho Veza e thusang batjha ba Afrika Borwa ho hlahloba mesebetsi, ho ithuta tsebo le ho fumana dibasari le mesebetsi.
consent.guardianWhatTitle: Seo re se bokellang le hore na hobaneng
consent.guardianWhat1: Lebitso, letsatsi la tswalo, nomoro ya mohala, profense, setereke, sekolo le kereiti, e le hore re bontshe dithuto tse nepahetseng.
consent.guardianWhat2: Tswelopele ya ho ithuta le diphetho tsa VR expo, e le hore re kgothaletse mehato e latelang.
consent.guardianWhat3: Ha ho mohla re rekisang tlhahisoleseding. Batshehetsi ba bona dipalo tse kopantsweng feela, ntle le haeba {name} a etsa kopo ya monyetla oo o o dumeletseng.
consent.guardianWhat4: O ka hula tumello neng kapa neng ka ho ikopanya le Veza.
consent.guardianThanks: Re a leboha. Kgetho ya hao e bolokilwe.
